notes.title: Welcome IDET. An enigmatic eldritch horror you didn’t know you craved.
notes.content:
IDET is a psychological horror tucked inside a cooking simulator skin.

[previewyoutube=JPGGVe2d0Jg;full][/previewyoutube]
How so?

On the surface, the only thing you need to do is to [color=#FF0000]meat[/color] your patrons’ expectations. But the master chefs know best what their patrons truly need. Use everything you can to be the best in your craft, even if it means sacrificing your patrons’ privacy… Watch them. Spy if necessary. Listen carefully to what they mean to say. Become someone they trust.

From now on, you live, work and dream of the Duskrise Diner. It’s the only place for you. Nowhere to escape, nothing else to desire. Protect what you have. Eliminate any threat to your perfect culinary existence.

Oh, what’s that? A [color=#FF0000]murder[/color]? Of your only competitor?! What a [strike]happy[/strike] sad-sad coincidence. Surely, there must be a way to deflect all the outrageous suspicions. You just have to keep your own [color=#FF0000]head[/color] cool and find the real culprit at any cost.

FEATURES:    Indulge in Decadent Eldritch Treats.    Tentacles, eyes, ichor, and bloody cupcakes — use everything you can to craft otherworldly culinary miracles that will satisfy even the most exquisite palate of your patrons no matter how picky they might be.
     Inspire Deep Everlasting Togetherness    Names. Tastes. Favorite dishes. What they dream of. What they need. A few pointers is all you need to [color=#FF0000]head[/color] the right way in the ever-changing maze of relationships. You must become the best friend you can. Friendships last forever, right? Well, that might be the only thing that counts in a place between Eternity and Tomorrow.
    Incrimination! Don’t Even Thinkaboutit!    Yeah, no. Murders are bad for business, so how dare anyone suspect you? This must be a plot against you. Use your skills to find out who did it. Any skills at your disposal — be it cooking, or a little bit of spying…
    Minigames.    You never know what the next order brings! The master chefs are always ready. Perfect your reaction time and adapt to any situation in an instant. Food runs away? Catch it. Missing some magic? Create it. You get the gist.

Before you go, just a little beat of something. All this food and murder talk must have made you thirsty — so take a sip of Freaked Fleapit, a wild cocktail of rhythm-based dungeon crawling and date sims. Get your heart racing as you dance through the 9 circles of Hell and lose your [color=#FF0000]head[/color] in blissful moments with the charming ladies of Freaked Fleapit.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840880/Freaked_Fleapit/

We’re so excited for you! Welcome to the rest of your fruitful life. If you can escape the blame for a murder you certainly didn’t commit.

Deblue and Critical Reflex

P.S. Join our Discord to know more about all things IDET, and a bunch of other cool games.
